Package com.example.lotterize

Class Event

java.lang.Object
com.example.lotterize.Event
public class Event extends Object
Represents an event. Contains all metadata about an event including owner, timing, registration status lists, participant limits, and QR reference. Firestore requires a public no-argument constructor and public getters/setters to properly deserialize objects.

  • Constructor Details

    • Event

      public Event()
      Required empty constructor for Firestore. DO NOT remove — Firestore uses reflection to populate fields.

    • Event

      public Event(String eventId, String ownerId, ArrayList<String> waitList, ArrayList<String> selectedList, ArrayList<String> cancelledList, ArrayList<String> finalList, String eventName, Timestamp date, Timestamp registrationStart, Timestamp registrationDeadline, String location, long totalSpots, String description, long entrantsLimit, String qrCode, String imageUrl)
      Full constructor for manually creating an Event.
      Parameters:
      eventId - Unique Firestore ID of the event (nullable until saved)
      ownerId - ID of organizer who created the event
      waitList - List of user IDs currently waiting
      selectedList - List of selected entrant IDs
      cancelledList - List of users who cancelled
      finalList - List of final confirmed users
      eventName - Display name of the event
      date - Timestamp when the event occurs
      registrationStart - Timestamp when sign-up opens
      registrationDeadline - Timestamp when sign-up closes
      location - Physical address or venue
      totalSpots - Maximum number of possible entrants
      description - Text description shown to users
      entrantsLimit - Limit on entries before selection/lottery
      qrCode - Reference string to QR image/data
      imageUrl - URL of event image

    • addEventDetailsFromSnapShot

      public static Event addEventDetailsFromSnapShot(DocumentSnapshot doc)
      This builds an Event object from a Firestore DocumentSnapshot. It reads all expected fields from the snapshot and initializes list fields to empty lists when they are missing.
      Parameters:
      doc - The snapshot that contains the Event document data
      Returns:
      Returns a new Event populated with values from the snapshot
